addedFiles.purpose: Seven device-free raw classification and registration RAII policy unit tests.

intent: Fix event handle leakage if SetEventHandle fails, by taking Handle RAII ownership immediately after CreateEventA.
Match raw WAIT_OBJECT_0/WAIT_TIMEOUT/WAIT_FAILED distinctly. Only WAIT_TIMEOUT is EventTimeout; preserve immediate thread Win32 error on WAIT_FAILED and raw unexpected result codes.
The pinned windows-core 0.62.2 uses windows-result 0.4.1, whose Error::from_thread is the renamed Error::from_win32 and reads GetLastError. No SetLastError workaround is introduced.

Library-only offline validation: remove 12 explicit example tables and the rand/simplelog/sysinfo dev-dependency tables. Package/lib/production dependency bytes and upstream library tests remain unchanged. All 12 published example source files remain unchanged.
Root workspace/member/patch/lock integration belongs to the main agent and is not part of this vendoring change.
